geographic.status.off: Location is off. UrAi will not request or store coordinates until you explicitly opt in.
geographic.status.waiting: Waiting for your browser permission. Nothing is stored by requesting access.
geographic.status.receivedPrecise: Location received under the current precise-location grant. Choose the stored precision and label before saving.
geographic.status.receivedApproximate: Location received and immediately reduced to approximate precision under the current privacy authority.
geographic.status.invalidCoordinate: The browser returned an invalid coordinate. Nothing was stored.
geographic.status.storageFailed: Consent could not be retained privately, so UrAi discarded the coordinate and kept location off.
geographic.status.permissionDenied: Location permission was denied or dismissed. No coordinates were stored.
geographic.status.deviceUnavailable: Location is unavailable right now. No coordinates were stored.
geographic.status.timeout: The location request timed out. No coordinates were stored.
geographic.status.failed: The location request failed. No coordinates were stored.
geographic.status.corruptRecordRemoved: An unreadable local location record was removed so hidden coordinates cannot survive without a working delete control.
geographic.status.pinsDeletedOtherTab: Location pins were deleted in another tab. This tab cleared its in-memory copy.
geographic.status.storageUnavailable: Private browser storage is unavailable. No location data can be retained on this device.
geographic.status.allClearedOtherTab: Local location data was cleared in another tab. This tab retained no coordinate or pin in memory.
geographic.status.consentRevokedOtherTab: UrAi location consent was revoked in another tab. No coordinate remains in memory here.
geographic.status.awaitingPolicy: The current location policy is awaiting server confirmation. No new coordinate can be requested or retained from cached or unconfirmed authority.
geographic.status.policyUnavailable: The authoritative location policy could not be read. New geographic collection remains blocked rather than guessing permission.
geographic.status.browserPermissionLost: Browser location permission is no longer granted. UrAi cleared its local consent flag and retained no coordinate in memory.
geographic.status.requestStorageUnavaila: Location remains off because private browser storage is unavailable. Nothing was requested or stored.
geographic.status.requestPolicyUnavailab: The authoritative location policy is not available yet. Browser geolocation was not requested.
geographic.status.unsupported: This browser does not provide geolocation. The symbolic Life Map remains available.
geographic.status.authorityChanged: Location authority changed before the request. Nothing was requested or stored; choose location again after the current policy is ready.
geographic.status.pinSaved: Memory pin saved locally with the selected authorized precision.
geographic.status.pinSaveFailed: The memory pin could not be saved. No existing location record changed.
geographic.status.revoked: Location permission inside UrAi is revoked. Existing saved pins remain until you delete them.
geographic.status.pinsDeleted: All locally stored geographic memory pins were deleted.
geographic.status.deletionUnverified: Private browser storage is unavailable, so deletion could not be verified on this device.
geographic.status.policyClosed: Consent Sanctuary has {mode} location collection. New browser location requests are blocked and no coordinate remains in memory.
geographic.status.policyBlocked: Consent Sanctuary has {mode} location collection. Browser geolocation was not requested.
geographic.title: Places, only when you choose.
geographic.consent.explanation: This layer never starts background collection. Browser location is requested only after you press the button below and the current Consent Sanctuary policy permits collection.
geographic.policy.signedOut: Signed-out local use is approximate-only; exact private location requires an authenticated Consent Sanctuary grant.
geographic.map.label: Geographic map fallback
geographic.map.primary: The symbolic Life Map remains the primary experience.
geographic.map.fallback: Interactive Google Maps will load only after restricted project keys are configured. This truthful fallback makes no external map request.
geographic.pin.label: Label
geographic.pins.title: Saved geographic memories
geographic.pins.empty: No geographic memory pins are stored.
